skill.summary: Organize, curate, and back up family photos from multiple sources using a stepwise workflow and a practical, non-prescriptive selection framework.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of family-photo-curation skill focused on organizing and curating family photo collections.
- Covers a full workflow from photo source inventory, deduplication, and selection to organizing and backup.
- Outlines best practices including folder structure design, selection criteria, and the 3-2-1 backup rule.
- Adds ongoing photo management routines and safety considerations.
- Excludes video management and general digital declutter; focuses strictly on still photos.
- Provides clear output format and practical real-life usage examples.
